title: Smiling Young Women Outside Cottage Home, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-20th-century outdoor snapshot capturing two cheerful young women sitting side by side along a decorative wire garden border in front of a cozy bungalow or cottage numbered 460. Both women sport classic 1940s curled hairstyles and light summer attire—one wearing a light top and skirt with loafers, the other wearing a floral printed short-sleeve dress and open-toed strap sandals. The lush front walkway is bordered with flowering plants, reflecting the idyllic domestic lifestyle of post-WWII America.
